message: ちちんぷいぷい

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn's rock-paper-scissors habit still isn't fixed... Hehehe.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yes!」

name: Synn
message: 「What is?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-Nothing! Come on, let's get fired up and go!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Our opponents for today's mock battle are the pair of Lolotte and Sally-chan, after all.」
In the rock-paper-scissors to divide into teams, both Nanaka and I threw rock.
Then, Misa and Ria-senpai threw scissors. Lolotte threw paper.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Normally, Sally-chan would be on offense and Lolo-chan on defense, right?」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm on offense, and Angel's on defense!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I will not allow only Omake-san to take the cool role!」

name: Sally
message: 「What was that?! I'm the stronger one here!」
We can hear every word

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gasp?! Omake-san, this is no time to be bickering!」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm on offense!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The President and the Treasurer can hear our entire conversation!」

name: Sally
message: 「Whaaat?! They're spies, aren't they?! That's dirty!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is a grave situation. In that case, to outsmart them, we should both go on defense--」

name: Sally
message: 「If we're doing that, I'd way rather have both of us go on offense!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmph. Let us compromise there, then.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gasp?! They overheard everything yet again!」

name: Sally
message: 「Not bad, Prez!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, you guys are just yelling at the top of your lungs.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn. Let's go hold our strategy meeting somewhere else.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yay! Alone at last!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, did you come up with a good strategy or something?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「O-Of course! Um, well, about Roro」

name: Synn
message: 「She's got healing abilities, so we'll have to do something about her」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, yeah. Right, right!」

name: Synn
message: 「How about this. First we focus on Sally」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And when Roro comes closer to help her, or gets her hands full healing, that's our chance to win, right」

name: Synn
message: 「Right then. We suddenly switch targets. The signal will be me flashing a peace sign」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. Sounds like that could totally work」
One of Nanaka's best traits is that she gets what you mean without you having to spell everything out.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, now that we've got a plan, shall we head back?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Darn it, I wasted such a great chance...」

name: Synn
message: 「Is something wrong?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Soba says she doesn't wanna go back yet」
Wait, could that mean...

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wha--what are you saying, you stupid panda!!」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right, Paqy! We're still in the middle of our strategy meeting, and if we go back now they'll overhear our plan--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah! That's why I don't wanna go back! Leave it to my childhood friend! You really get me!」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Of course I do. We've known each other forever, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Though you never get the most important part...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've gotta be way more proactive!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, a change of plans? Though, charging straight in out of nowhere seems pretty reckless...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, uh, no, well, strategies and stuff just aren't really my style, so I kinda prefer just winging it, y'know. Ahaha」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm fine with that, though. In real combat, you have to find a chance to win while fighting.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...You're so serious.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd prefer it if you called it my usual self.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just playing it by ear, huh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Watch your step!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, ah!」
Nanaka's feet get tangled, and just as she's about to fall, I reach out to catch her.
However, I don't make it in time, and the two of us end up tripping together.
A soft sensation presses against my palm. There is a swelling there, larger than it looks.
Still sprawled on the ground, the two of us blink in unison.
I-I just grabbed Nanaka's boobs... square on.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Kyaa!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry!!」
When I pull my hand back in a panic, Nanaka crosses both arms to cover her chest.
I've never seen her react like this before... even though we're childhood friends...
Right now, I'm painfully aware of Nanaka as a girl.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I should be the one... apologizing. I was just a little startled.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I mean... uh... I-I touched you, so...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「D-Don't say it like that! Come on, forget it already! It's embarrassing, you know!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... s-sorry.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well... that was basically an accident. Besides... you were trying to save me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, thanks...」

name: Synn
message: 「Anyway... are you okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, yeah. It's no big deal.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! You're bleeding!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hocus pocus! Pain, pain, go away!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What kind of embarrassing thing are you saying?!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, I mean! We used to do this for each other all the time back in the day」
Though I was mostly the one doing it for Nanaka, since she was always running around getting scraped up.
Feeling a bit embarrassed, I end up changing the subject.

name: Nanaka
message: 「D-Don't do weird stuff like that at our age!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just go ahead and lick the wound already. I'm sure she'd love it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-W-W-W-Who the hell would love that!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just imagine it. Master Synn's soft, warm tongue crawling all around the edge of your wound」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Should I?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't have to! A little scratch like this is nothing!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Good grief」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's go back, let's go back! It'd be bad to keep our opponents waiting!」
I do like it best when Nanaka is her usual energetic self, though.
Seeing this unfamiliar side of Nanaka, before I knew it, my heart wouldn't stop pounding.
